items.title: David Spinozza interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, NY, September 27, 2025
items.q: I love the charts that Bobby Brookmeyer, “Willow Weep for me” I remember all that stuff

ctx.x: I have to hear this story again.

Well I used to go, on Monday nights I’d go down, because I was always loving big band stuff. And I would call myself, as far as jazz, I’d call myself a closet jazzer. ‘Cause I practice jazz at home and I used to listen to Wes Montgomery records and you know, Joe Pass, and all that stuff. And I would learn the stuff but I never really played out. I never played jazz in a club or anything. I didn’t do that. But I was fascinated with the arranging of big band stuff. So Monday nights I would go down to the Village…
